final: WITH account_region AS (SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 AS region_name, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type COLLATE BINARY = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type COLLATE BINARY = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS signed_total, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3), region_total AS (SELECT region_name, SUM(signed_total) AS signed_total FROM account_region GROUP BY region_name) SELECT ar.account_id, ar.region_name, ar.signed_total, ar.record_count, 1.0 * ar.signed_total / rt.signed_total AS ratio FROM account_region AS ar JOIN region_total AS rt ON ar.region_name COLLATE BINARY = rt.region_name ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
